doc.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

title: Leaving the Air Force, Philadelphia and his wife's encouragement
summary: He leaves the Air Force after about five more years, moves to Philadelphia, and his wife of 40 years encourages his music.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So, when did you decide that again you needed to exit from the Air Force?
About four or five years later. Five years later. I exited the Air Force and then went to Philly. And I was married to my wife, who I’ve been married to for about 40 years, the same woman, huh?
Yeah. It’s amazing. She is the one that encouraged the musical thing. She says, “you might be sorry someday if you don’t do that.” And it took a lot on her part to do that.
Yeah, sure. Especially when you start doing road work.
